title: Evaluation, Safety, and Guardrails
description: Know when a Gen AI feature is good enough to ship, and keep it safe once it's live.
learningOutcomes: Build a lightweight evaluation harness for LLM output
Explain the main failure modes of LLM features in production

lessons.title: Building an Eval Set
lessons.description: A small, versioned set of cases you check every time a prompt changes.
learningObjectives: Re-run evals before shipping a prompt change

lessons.title: Using a Model as a Judge
lessons.description: When and how to use an LLM to grade another LLM's output.
learningObjectives: Design a grading rubric an LLM can apply
Combine LLM judging with human spot checks

lessons.title: Input and Output Guardrails
lessons.description: Filter what goes in and validate what comes out.
learningObjectives: Detect and block obvious prompt injection
Validate output against a schema before using it
Add a moderation/safety check to a pipeline

lessons.title: Production Failure Modes
lessons.description: Hallucination, drift, rate limits, and outages — and how to fail gracefully.
learningObjectives: Design a fallback when the model API is down
Handle rate limits without dropping user requests
